title: Repeated radius-loss derivative budget obstruction for the Q3 history candidate
question: Can the formal bi-entire radius-loss derivative estimates supply a volume-independent C^n bound for arbitrarily long Q3 histories at a fixed positive radius?

model.coefficient_space: weighted l1 coefficients in q,v,a with radii (R_q,R_v,S)
model.witness: f_n(a)=a^n has ||f_n||_S=S^n and ||D_a^n f_n||_(S')=n! for every 0<S'<=S
model.asymptotic: n!/S^n is superexponential in n, so no fixed C gives ||D_a^n||<=C^n for all n
model.orientation: The same source radius is used for both source-centered orientations

scope.not_closed: The obstruction removes only the pure repeated radius-loss derivative envelope. It does not rule out cancellations, non-Leibniz analytic/Frechet estimates, symmetric or state-weighted seminorms, an actual Q3 common core, a thermodynamic history, QFT reconstruction, the gap, the continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The field/source radii, actual source polynomial and local coefficient rate are re-read from the registered upstream manifests; the factorial witness is a test vector, not a fitted physical datum.
The lower bound applies to the formal pure source derivative D_a^n; it is not silently identified with every Q3 commutator word.
The witness output is constant after n derivatives, so shrinking the final radius does not remove the n!/S^n growth; this rejects only this repeated-derivative strategy.
The finite order-8 and order-32 comparisons are diagnostics; the all-n statement uses the elementary factorial lower bound and is not promoted to an operator theorem.
The branch count is retained only as a comparison base; no volume-uniform factorial spatial incidence is inferred from it.
Lean R289 checks rational radii, factorial witnesses and the discrete lower-bound fixture only; it does not formalize coefficient completions, unbounded operators or limits.
No KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production owner follows.

qft_interface.closed: The registered formal source radii and orientation rate are consistent, and the pure repeated radius-loss derivative envelope has superexponential n!/S^n growth.
qft_interface.open: An actual Q3 common-core estimate must exploit cancellations or a topology with derivative closure; factorial spatial incidence, first passage, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian/KMS identification, OS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied by this analytic boundary test.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing route boundary. The pure repeated radius-loss derivative architecture is parked; the result is not a no-go theorem for the actual Q3 dynamics or for stronger analytic, symmetric, state-weighted or modular constructions.
next_action: Construct a genuinely derivative-closed Q3 common-core or state-weighted seminorm with explicit cancellations and both orientations; if it cannot produce a volume-uniform factorial history, register that separate obstruction before any QFT promotion.
